name: @jhlagado/edit
description: A small portable Z80 text editor for CP/M-compatible systems

scripts.test: node test/prove-editor.mjs && node test/editor-engine-boundaries.mjs && node test/editor-session-boundaries.mjs && node test/editor-gap-boundaries.mjs && node test/atom-native.mjs && node test/editor-display-boundaries.mjs
scripts.check: node tools/check-assembler-policy.mjs && node tools/check-document-boundary.mjs && npm run build && npm test && npm run measure:engine && npm run measure:gap && npm run measure:display
scripts.measure: npm run measure:buffers && npm run measure:search && npm run measure:new-file && npm run measure:replace
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run build:release
